# SNXA Medical

> > SNXA Medical is a China-based manufacturer and wholesale supplier of medical protective equipment including nitrile, latex, and vinyl gloves, face masks (FFP2, N95, surgical), syringes, and healthcare supplies with CE, FDA, EN 455, and ASTM certifications.

SNXA Medical specializes in disposable medical gloves for healthcare, food handling, and industrial applications, offering powder-free and latex-free options. The company provides educational resources on glove selection, sterilization standards, and maintains COVID-19 pandemic updates for the healthcare community.

## Key Topics

- Nitrile gloves
- Latex gloves
- PVC/Vinyl gloves
- Powder-free gloves
- CE certification
- FDA approval
- EN 455 standard
- EN 374 standard
- ASTM D6319
- Food-grade gloves
- Latex-free products
- Disposable medical gloves
- Healthcare PPE
- COVID-19 protective equipment
- Wholesale medical supplies

## Medical & Protective Gloves

- [Pink Nitrile Gloves](https://www.snxamedical.com/gloves-series/protective-gloves/pink-nitrile-gloves.html): Pink nitrile gloves with CE, EN 455/374 certification for medical use
- [Textured Nitrile Gloves](https://www.snxamedical.com/gloves-series/protective-gloves/textured-nitrile-gloves.html): Textured nitrile gloves: powder-free, chemical resistant, latex-free
- [Powder Free Vinyl Exam Gloves Medium](https://www.snxamedical.com/gloves-series/medical-gloves/powder-free-vinyl-exam-gloves-medium.html): Medium powder-free vinyl exam gloves: PVC, CE/FDA/EN455 certified
- [Disposable Vinyl Examination Gloves](https://www.snxamedical.com/gloves-series/medical-gloves/disposable-vinyl-examination-gloves.html): Disposable vinyl exam gloves: PVC, powder-free, EN455/EN374 standards
- [Food Grade Nitrile Examination Gloves](https://www.snxamedical.com/gloves-series/medical-gloves/food-grade-nitrile-examination-gloves.html): Food-grade nitrile exam gloves: NBR, CE/FDA certified, latex-free
- [Vinyl Gloves Food Grade](https://www.snxamedical.com/gloves-series/protective-gloves/vinyl-gloves-food-grade.html): Food-grade vinyl gloves: PVC, powder-free, FDA approved for food safety
